injuries.detail: Concussion  - Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Atlanta.
Hamstring Strain - Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Hamstring Strain - Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Calf Strain - McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
Back Strain - Flemings (back) is out for Friday's game against the Hornets, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Hamstring  - Williams (hamstring) is listed as out for Friday's game versus the Hawks.
Hip Inflammation - Landale (hip) won't play in Friday's game against the Hornets, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Foot Fracture - Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

Toe  - Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Knee  - Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
Ankle Sprain - Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Knee Not Specified - Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.
Hamstring Strain - Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
Ankle Sprain - Nelson (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Orlando.

Ankle Surgery - Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
Hamstring Strain - Haliburton (hamstring) is expected to miss at least two more weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Toe Sprain - Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.
Ankle  - Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Indiana.
Knee  - Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Knee Surgery - Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.
Back  - Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
Hamstring Strain - Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Knee Inflammation - Leonard (knee) could return in the next few weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Quadriceps Strain - Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.
Concussion  - Murray-Boyles (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pistons.
Hamstring Strain - Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
Knee Surgery - Prince (knee) underwent surgery to address lingering issues and has no timeline for a return, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
Knee Bruise - Holland (knee) has been upgraded to doubtful for Friday's game against Toronto, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
Oblique Strain - Okorie (oblique) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Toronto.
Foot Fracture - Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Foot  - Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.
Hand  - Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Knee Surgery - The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
Illness  - Smith (illness) is out for Friday's game against the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
Foot Not Specified - Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
Hip Pinched Nerve - Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.
Back  - Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.
Back Strain - Okpara (illness) is available for Friday's game against Toronto.
Shoulder  - The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
Ankle  - Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
Knee  - Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

Leg Fracture - Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.
Shoulder Surgery - Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Hip Soreness - Caruso (hip) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Pelicans.
Foot Plantar Fasciitis - Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.
Ankle Sprain - Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Oklahoma City.
Elbow Infection - McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.
Hip Soreness - Topic (hip) is out for Friday's game against New Orleans.

Knee  - Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.
Hand Fracture - Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Knee Not Specified - Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Foot Strain - Nurkic (foot) has been cleared for on-court work and will be re-evaluated in one week.
Shoulder Surgery - Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Eye  - Sengun (eye) is questionable for Friday's game against the Nuggets.
Quadriceps Bruise - Adams (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Denver.
Knee Sprain - Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
Ankle Sprain - Capela (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Denver.
Heel Bruise - Reaves (heel) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Kings.
Hip Soreness - Hunter (hip) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Lakers.
Knee Dislocated - Raynaud (knee) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Suns.
Lower Leg Bruise - Achiuwa (lower leg) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Lakers.
Achilles Surgery - Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
